summary:
Facepalm: Two facepalm candidates found and verified: Marblehead hat dispute (local pairing) and the 11 Democrats who missed the Hegseth vote. Wider odd-news searches turned up little new inside the window. Genius: Genius scan for 2026-11-16 found two candidates that fit the rules: the Chandra discovery of a hidden compact companion behind a repeating supernova impostor (University of Virginia-led, with NASA and Space.com pages), and the oldest known compact quasar pair (Gemini North in Hawaii, with Space.com and NOIRLab). The Starship upper-stage catch is already on the bench, so it was not re-proposed. Most other leads failed on sourcing, because the only coverage came from publishers that are not on the accepted list.</summary>
